title: Matthew Stafford, Davante Adams shine as Rams beat Giants in Aaron Donald's return

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Matthew Stafford, Davante Adams shine as Rams beat Giants in Aaron Donald's return
sources.description: Matthew Stafford and Davante Adams put on a show as the Rams rediscover their swagger in Aaron Donald's much-anticipated return, beating the Giants 28-6.
